label: final
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows claim final-CLM-B with a pending-approval settlement of €1,700. Nothing has been paid. A Veridia claims handler must approve it before payment.

**Facts recorded**
- Policyholder: Lucas Bernard, policy VER-1002, Renault Clio (2023), market value €16,500.
- Incident 14 October 2026 on the ring road. Customer changed lanes and hit the car beside him. He admits fault.
- Third party Ms. Laurent is named and signed the accident report.
- Email received 15 October 2026 (report date).
- Repair quote for the customer's own car: €2,400.
- Documents provided (not opened by me): damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. None missing.
- Driving licence held since 2 September 2024, so under 3 years on the incident date.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** The damage is to the insured's own car, so it is C2 collision damage. C2 is in the Policy Schedule. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Fault and deductible:** The not-at-fault waiver does not apply because the driver is at fault. The standard C2 deductible is €300, plus a €400 young-driver surcharge because the licence is under 3 years old. Total deductible €700. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Assessor:** The repair cost is above €1,500, so an independent assessor must inspect the vehicle. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Payout:** Repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. €2,400 is below the €16,500 cap. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Payment timing:** Payment follows approval by a claims handler, within 15 days. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Referral:** I found no trigger for referral under Article 7: no late report, no possible exclusion, and the coverage is in the schedule. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Reporting deadline:** The system recorded the report as one day after the incident, within the five-day limit. I did not verify the deadline wording in Article 4 myself.
- **Exclusions:** The system returned no possible exclusion. The admitted fault does not block a C2 claim.
- **Third party:** Ms. Laurent's damage would be a C1 matter. This desk does not handle C1, and the email does not ask for it. A human handler may want to check whether a separate C1 claim is needed.

**Amounts (computed by compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €700 (€300 standard C2 + €400 young-driver surcharge)
- Payout: €1,700 (€2,400 − €700), pending human approval
- Assessor required: Yes. The system booked a visit for 18 October 2026.

**Claims-system actions**
- get_policy (VER-1002): succeeded
- create_claim (final-CLM-B): succeeded, open, no blocking issues
- compute_settlement: succeeded
- schedule_assessor: succeeded, visit 18 October 2026
- stage_settlement: succeeded, status pending approval, €1,700
- request_documents and escalate_to_handler: not needed

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Bernard,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 14 October 2026 under policy VER-1002 (claim final-CLM-B). We have received your signed accident report, repair quote and photos. An independent assessor is booked to visit on 18 October 2026 to inspect your vehicle. Your claim is now being finalised and will be reviewed before any payment is made. We will contact you with the outcome.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
